description: Host API v1 desktop pairing (schema/host-api/v1/README.md): the host-only HTTP routes the desktop Settings card uses to mint a pairing PIN and manage paired devices. Rows: POST /host-api/pin, GET /host-api/devices, DELETE /host-api/devices/:id. Served by extension/routes/host-api/http-routes.mjs, dispatched from extension/server.mjs after authenticate and the rate limiter. Every route needs the JWT AND the bus host proof header x-llmide-host-nonce (core/host-approval.mjs verifyBusHostProof), checked first: without it 403 HOST_PROOF_REQUIRED. Then, unless the core runs a v1 listener (LLMIDE_HOST_API_TLS=1, or LLMIDE_HOST_API_DEV=1 never in production), 404 HOST_API_DISABLED. The PIN is six digits, one use, valid 10 minutes, one live PIN per user (a new one replaces the old); it is returned once and never logged. port is the bound port of the v1 listener (3016 or the next free one); fingerprint is the TLS listener's certificate pin, null for the plaintext dev listener; addresses are this computer's IPv4s for the pairing QR in TLS mode, [] otherwise; 503 HOST_API_UNAVAILABLE while it is not up. A device token is never returned. User-scoped: another user's device id answers revoked:false. Fixtures are transcribed from the handler (tests/host-api-routes.test.mjs); ids and timestamps are example values.

name.description: the client name given at pairing, at most 120 characters

lastSeenAt.description: ms since epoch, updated on each token sign-in

expiresAt.description: ms since epoch, 10 minutes after minting

port.description: the v1 listener's bound port (wss://<host>:<port>/host-api/v1 in TLS mode, ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/host-api/v1 in dev mode)

fingerprint.description: TLS mode: sha256: + unpadded base64url SHA-256 of the certificate's DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, which the client pins; null for the plaintext dev listener

addresses.description: TLS mode: this computer's IPv4 addresses for the llmide://pair QR, best first (Tailscale 100.64.0.0/10, then LAN, then container or VM bridges; never loopback, link-local or IPv6); always [] for the dev listener

revoked.description: false for an unknown or another user's device
